name: Material You Colors (KDE/Qt & terminals)
description: Applies the wallpaper palette to KDE/Qt apps, Konsole, KSyntaxHighlighting, window decorations and terminals. Every setting here is re-read by the wallpaper switcher too, so it stays in effect on the next wallpaper change.
author: bhavya

settings.label: Wallpaper colour to theme from
settings.description: The wallpaper is scored down to seven colours, best first. 0 is the one the shell itself uses; raise it to theme KDE from a different colour in the same image.

settings.label: Contrast
settings.description: Pushes foreground and background apart. 0 is the Material default.

settings.label: Saturation
settings.description: Multiplies the colourfulness of every role. 1 is unchanged, 0 is grey.

settings.label: Lightness
settings.description: Multiplies the lightness of every role. 1 is unchanged.

settings.label: Frame contrast
settings.description: How visible the borders between panes are in Qt apps.

settings.label: Toolbar opacity, light
settings.description: Applied to the window chrome of Qt apps in the light scheme.

settings.label: Theme terminals
settings.description: Writes foot's palette file and repaints open terminals, including the 256-colour slots the shell prompt uses. Turn this off to manage terminal colours yourself.

settings.label: Write pywal files
settings.description: ~/.cache/wal/*, for anything that reads a pywal palette.

settings.label: Terminal light/dark
settings.description: Terminals can stay dark while the rest of the session goes light.

settings.label: Theme Konsole
settings.description: Writes a Konsole colour scheme and switches open windows onto it.

settings.label: Theme window decorations
settings.description: Breeze and Sierra Breeze Enhanced button colours, Klassy's outline, and KWin's rounded-corner outline. Each one is only touched if it is actually installed, so this does nothing under Hyprland alone.

settings.label: Set titlebar opacity
settings.description: Off leaves Klassy and Sierra Breeze Enhanced's own opacity settings alone, which is different from setting them to 100%.

settings.label: Darker titlebar for
settings.description: Space separated window classes that get a darker titlebar, via a KWin rule. Needs KWin.

settings.label: Run after applying
settings.description: A shell command, run once the colours are on disk. $KDE_MATERIAL_YOU_JSON, $KDE_MATERIAL_YOU_MODE and $KDE_MATERIAL_YOU_SCHEME are set for it.
